responsibility: Defines CSKY inline-assembly register classes and registers, specifying supported integer and floating-point operand types, accepted register aliases, reserved-register diagnostics, and assembly emission for valid operands.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `abi/call/csky.rs`, this CSKY file defines the inline `asm!` register set and validation—general/floating registers, aliases, supported types, and reserved-register errors—rather than function-call ABI coercion rules.
